# IBM Db2 TechX Summit 2026 — Project Submission

> **PR Title Format:** `[Submission] db2-smartstock-ai: SmartStock AI - Food Waste & Inventory Optimizer`
> **Folder Format:** `submissions/db2-smartstock-ai/`

---

## 1. Project Overview

- **Project Title:** SmartStock AI: Food Waste & Inventory Optimizer with IBM Db2
- **Project Slug:** `submissions/db2-smartstock-ai/`
- **Short Description:** An enterprise-grade food waste reduction and inventory optimization platform powered by IBM Db2, Machine Learning (LightGBM, Random Forest), and autonomous Multi-Agent AI (CrewAI / LangChain architecture).
- **Problem Solved & Target Audience:** Commercial kitchens and food service operators lose billions annually to avoidable spoilage. SmartStock AI enforces First-Expired, First-Out (FEFO) batch inventory allocation, predicts spoilage risks before expiration, forecasts multi-horizon consumption, matches near-expiry ingredients to recipes, and coordinates an autonomous multi-agent restock assistant.

## 3. IBM Db2 Integration Summary

- **IBM Db2 Edition / Environment:** IBM Db2 Community Edition (Docker container `db2server`)
- **How IBM Db2 is Used in the Solution:** Serves as the core relational and transactional database for 12 tables, managing batch-level FEFO tracking, consumption transactions, immutable stock movement audit trails, dynamic financial rollups, and natural language Text-to-SQL querying.
- **Db2 Connector / Driver / Framework Integration Used:** Native `ibm_db` Python driver via container execution bridge with local SQLite mirror caching for fast reads and offline resilience.
- **Schema & Data Stored / Processed:** 12 relational tables: `SUPPLIERS`, `INGREDIENTS`, `INVENTORY`, `CONSUMPTION`, `STOCK_MOVEMENTS`, `RECIPES`, `RECIPE_INGREDIENTS`, `WASTE_RECORDS`, `PURCHASE_ORDERS`, `DEMAND_FORECASTS`, `USERS`, and `VECTOR_STORAGE`.
- **Steps to Verify Db2 Integration:** Run `python tests/test_smartstock.py` to execute the automated 10-suite verification test covering Db2 health, FEFO sorting, and transactional consumption.

---

## 4. Technology Stack & AI / LLM Usage

- **Programming Languages:** Python 3.11
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** FastAPI, Streamlit, LightGBM, Scikit-Learn, Pandas, Plotly, CrewAI, LangChain
- **AI / LLM Framework:** CrewAI / LangChain sequential multi-agent orchestration
- **Model Provider & Model Name:** Local LM Studio (`liquid/lfm2.5-1.2b`) or IBM watsonx.ai Granite models
- **Where AI/LLM is Applied in the Workflow:**
  1. Spoilage risk classification & excess volume regression (LightGBM).
  2. Multi-horizon demand forecasting (1-day, 3-day, 7-day).
  3. 6-agent autonomous restock & optimization crew.
  4. Natural language assistant with read-only SQL safety guards.
